request.style: English, solemn modern hymn, clear male tenor with mixed choir, piano, strings, soft organ, reverent and luminous, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He served the widows at the table
He spoke with wisdom and with grace
And all who sat in the council
Saw a face like an angel's face

[Verse]
They could not stand against his wisdom
They could not answer what he said
So they covered their ears and screamed
And they rushed at him instead

[Chorus]
Look, I see heaven opened
And the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God
Lord Jesus, receive my spirit
Lord Jesus, receive my spirit

[Verse]
They dragged him out of the city
They laid their cloaks at Saul's feet
And as the stones were falling
His prayer was strong and sweet

[Chorus]
Look, I see heaven opened
And the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God
Lord Jesus, receive my spirit
Lord Jesus, receive my spirit

[Bridge]
Then he fell to his knees and cried out with a loud voice
Lord, do not hold this sin against them
And with these words he fell asleep

[Outro]
Lord Jesus, receive my spirit
